items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oscar [Peterson] said he looked like an old British butler. He said, “Home James. I say there . . .” So we used to call him – lovingly, we called him Smedley

ctx.x: Smedley, because Oscar [Peterson] said he looked like an old British butler. He said, “Home James. I say there . . .” So we used to call him – lovingly, we called him Smedley, but not too many people would call him that. Like not too many people call Miles [Davis] Inky, either.
